Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing, architecture and process-data review of NTCore .NET Generic Unpacker and DynLogger; no payload, target process or dump executed

NetUnpacker.Description: Dumps/unpacks packed .NET applications. Publisher directs using x64 only for a non-x86 target process, otherwise use x86. No supported Windows version list or product-specific license grant is stated on the product page.

DynLogger.Description: Logs dynamically retrieved functions by module/requested-function names and loaded modules, saving a log after the monitored process exits. Publisher says it was tested on Windows XP and Vista, x86/x64, and .NET applications; no newer target list or product-specific license grant is stated.

DownloadPage.Observation: The page lists both products as NTCore utilities but does not provide a clear license grant for either. Its explicit statement 'There are no license restrictions' is attached to DisasMSIL, a different source project, and must not be generalized to these binaries.

ReviewFindings: All four retained ZIP hashes were recomputed and match the frozen inventory. Each archive contains the expected architecture; each DynLogger package contains the executable and two matching-architecture DLLs. No license or redistribution notice was recorded in these archive member inventories.

Both tools act on a target process. Generic Unpacker dumps/unpacks packed .NET applications; DynLogger captures loaded-module and dynamically retrieved function names and writes a log on process exit. Exact injection, privilege, compatibility, target/output path and data-persistence behavior are not established by static evidence.

Architecture selection follows target-process bitness, not host bitness. Do not attach to or dump any real process. Any later check requires an owned synthetic target, exact matched files, isolated output, and a separately reviewed compatibility and recovery path.
No explicit product-specific license/redistribution terms were found in current pages reviewed. The separate DisasMSIL license statement does not grant rights for .NET Generic Unpacker or DynLogger.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Current publisher versions and architecture instructions, stated features, DynLogger XP/Vista test claim, and retained archive pins are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Product-specific licensing, target support beyond publisher-era claims, process-hook/dump mechanics, output/data handling, current-build compatibility, UI and activation remain unresolved.
Deferred: No unpacking or instrumentation of real or Defender-blocked targets; any later isolated check must use an owned synthetic process.
Clarify product-specific use/distribution rights; do not infer rights from DisasMSIL.
No Windows 11/Server support is established by the XP/Vista DynLogger test claim or generic unpacker page.
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: Version/architecture and process-data scope are clearer, but license, runtime/recovery and target gates remain; no whole outcome closed.
